changelog:
Chinese Almanac v2.0.0

- Added support for five new languages: Vietnamese, Thai, Malay, Hindi, in addition to existing English, Chinese, and Japanese.
- Updated documentation to include localized descriptions and usage instructions for each new language.
- Expanded online demo links for all supported languages.
- No changes to core functionality—this update focuses on enhanced multilingual access and documentation.
